skill_name: Compare and contrast the countries India and Brazil.
workflow: India and Brazil are both large countries in terms of population, area, and GDP. India has a population of over 1.2 billion while Brazil has a population of 212 million. India is the seventh-largest country in the world by area while Brazil is the fifth-largest. India has the seventh-largest economy in the world while Brazil has the tenth-largest.
